description: This file contains implementation of a compressed bitmap data structure (ewah_bitmap) with functions for manipulation, iteration, set operations, and memory management, specifically related to EWAH (Efficient Word Aligned Hybrid) compression.

methods.name: size_t min_size(size_t a,size_t b)
methods.description: Computes the minimum of two sizes.

methods.name: size_t max_size(size_t a,size_t b)
methods.description: Computes the maximum of two sizes.

methods.name: void buffer_grow(struct ewah_bitmap * self,size_t new_size)
methods.description: Grows the buffer of the ewah_bitmap to accommodate new size.

methods.name: void buffer_push(struct ewah_bitmap * self,eword_t value)
methods.description: Pushes a new word into the buffer.

methods.name: void buffer_push_rlw(struct ewah_bitmap * self,eword_t value)
methods.description: Pushes a run length word into the buffer.

methods.name: size_t add_empty_words(struct ewah_bitmap * self,int v,size_t number)
methods.description: Adds a specified number of empty (all 0s or all 1s) words.

methods.name: size_t ewah_add_empty_words(struct ewah_bitmap * self,int v,size_t number)
methods.description: Adds empty words of a specific bit value.

methods.name: size_t add_literal(struct ewah_bitmap * self,eword_t new_data)
methods.description: Adds a literal word to the bitmap.

methods.name: void ewah_add_dirty_words(struct ewah_bitmap * self,const eword_t * buffer,size_t number,int negate)
methods.description: Adds a buffer of words, possibly negated, to the bitmap.

methods.name: size_t add_empty_word(struct ewah_bitmap * self,int v)
methods.description: Adds a single empty word of specified bit value.

methods.name: size_t ewah_add(struct ewah_bitmap * self,eword_t word)
methods.description: Adds a word, handling zeros, ones, or literals.

methods.name: void ewah_set(struct ewah_bitmap * self,size_t i)
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in the bitmap.

methods.name: void ewah_each_bit(struct ewah_bitmap * self,void (* callback)(size_t,void *),void * payload)
methods.description: Iterates over each bit, invoking a callback.

methods.name: void ewah_clear(struct ewah_bitmap * self)
methods.description: Resets the bitmap to an empty state.

methods.name: struct:ewah_bitmap * ewah_new(void)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new ewah_bitmap.

methods.name: void ewah_free(struct ewah_bitmap * self)
methods.description: Frees the memory associated with the bitmap.

methods.name: void read_new_rlw(struct ewah_iterator * it)
methods.description: Reads and loads a new run length word during iteration.

methods.name: int ewah_iterator_next(eword_t * next,struct ewah_iterator * it)
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next word.

methods.name: void ewah_iterator_init(struct ewah_iterator * it,struct ewah_bitmap * parent)
methods.description: Initializes an iterator for a given bitmap.

methods.name: void ewah_or_iterator_init(struct ewah_or_iterator * it,struct ewah_bitmap ** parents,size_t nr)
methods.description: Initializes an OR iterator for multiple bitmaps.

methods.name: int ewah_or_iterator_next(eword_t * next,struct ewah_or_iterator * it)
methods.description: Gets the next OR combination of bits.

methods.name: void ewah_or_iterator_release(struct ewah_or_iterator * it)
methods.description: Releases resources held by the OR iterator.

methods.name: void ewah_xor(struct ewah_bitmap * ewah_i,struct ewah_bitmap * ewah_j,struct ewah_bitmap * out)
methods.description: Calculates the XOR of two bitmaps into an output bitmap.

methods.name: struct:ewah_bitmap * ewah_pool_new(void)
methods.description: Provides a new bitmap from pool or creates a new one.

methods.name: void ewah_pool_free(struct ewah_bitmap * self)
methods.description: Returns a bitmap to the pool or frees it.

methods.name: uint32_t ewah_checksum(struct ewah_bitmap * self)
methods.description: Computes a checksum of the bitmap for integrity verification.

ctags.pattern: /^static size_t add_empty_words(struct ewah_bitmap *self, int v, size_t number)$/

ctags.pattern: /^static inline void buffer_grow(struct ewah_bitmap *self, size_t new_size)$/

ctags.name: buffer_push
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void buffer_push(struct ewah_bitmap *self, eword_t value)$/

ctags.name: ewah_add_dirty_words
ctags.signature: (struct ewah_bitmap * self,const eword_t * buffer,size_t number,int negate)

ctags.name: ewah_add_empty_words
ctags.pattern: /^size_t ewah_add_empty_words(struct ewah_bitmap *self, int v, size_t number)$/

ctags.name: ewah_xor

ctags.name: max_size
ctags.pattern: /^static inline size_t max_size(size_t a, size_t b)$/

ctags.pattern: /^static inline size_t min_size(size_t a, size_t b)$/
